direction: New small-ensemble engineering briefing score: electric bass, light kit/claves/shaker, low brass verdicts, timpani, bells and mallets. No piano/string pad. Both silence windows retain only room tone; ship horn J-cuts and tuned reveal match the reference direction.

sections.intent: Hook D-minor brass snap then muted bass groove A
Piers and approaching ship, light kit and low-pass-feeling reduction
Stamp D-minor impact and half-time aftermath
Rule groove rebuilt, ruler ring and projection ticks
Test bench groove B, landing stabs and sour rejection brass
Chromatic bass crawl, shaker swell, paired horn verdict
Dominant landing, snare build, bright B-flat rocket and vibraphone ring
Whole-note bass and soft trombone under ship
D-major reveal chord, tuned ship horn and falling horn verdict with glockenspiel
